<Heading
  as={"h1"}

  children={"Save a unit file"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/plugin-api/service-manager/{hostId}/units/{unit}/file"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Checks the text with systemd-analyze verify, then writes the unit to /etc/systemd/system or its override.conf drop-in, keeps a .termix.bak copy and reloads systemd. An empty override removes it.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>
  <Translate id="theme.openapi.request.title">Request</Translate>
</Heading>

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"in":"path","name":"hostId","required":true,"schema":{"type":"integer"}},{"in":"path","name":"unit","required":true,"schema":{"type":"string"}}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>

<RequestSchema
  title={"Body"}
  body={{"required":true,"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"target":{"type":"string","enum":["unit","override"]},"text":{"type":"string"}}}}}}}
>
  
</RequestSchema>

<StatusCodes
  responses={{"200":{"description":"Saved."},"400":{"description":"The check failed. Nothing was written."}}}
>
  
</StatusCodes>
